hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored jarqueBeraTest reproduces scipy.stats.jarque_bera BIT-FOR-BIT for both the statistic and the p-value; and the test REJECTS normality (JB above the 95% chi-square critical value) even though signalMoments finds the distribution descriptively near-Gaussian -- the large-N power nuance.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: jarqueBeraTest equals scipy.stats.jarque_bera to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); the statistic exceeds the 95% critical value
